info.title: endoflife.date
info.description: Community-maintained release and support dates, keyless. For Spring Boot each cycle names the Java versions it supports.

get.description: An array of `{cycle, releaseDate, eol, extendedSupport, latest, latestReleaseDate, lts, supportedJavaVersions}`. Products: spring-boot, spring-framework, java (as `oracle-jdk`, `eclipse-temurin`), hibernate-orm, apache-tomcat.
